caption: Every member added later inherits all three grants immediately.

code:
ALTER ROLE SalesAnalystRole ADD MEMBER [DOMAIN\jsmith];

ALTER ROLE SalesAnalystRole DROP MEMBER [DOMAIN\jsmith];
caption: A Mover gets dropped from the old role and added to the new one.
